intro.fallback: The opening scene of the movie shows Naruto fighting a monster, only to be killed by it.

Going back a few days before this, a man named Yomi and his four subordinates attacked a shrine to retrieve the spirit of Mōryō, a demon who attempted to destroy the world and create his "Thousand Year Kingdom".
Since he lacked a body, Yomi offered his as a temporary substitute until they could retrieve Mōryō's true body, which is sealed in another shrine.

outro.fallback: Meanwhile, Neji orders Sakura to escape with Shion, learning too late that his two opponents were actually just one man and a puppet meant to distract him.
The last assassin catches up to Sakura, knocking her out with poison and killing Shion.
